text:
Matthew G: Quick question — prototyping a 'sampling_rate' guardrail for runtime configs so big cohort rollouts don't accidentally smash quotas. Thinking platform-level default + per-route overrides with a hard max for non-admins.

Sana R: can you paste a quick sketch of the config?

Matthew G: sketch: ```json
{
  "policy": "route_by_cost",
  "overrides": {
    "cohort": "beta-testers",
    "sampling_rate": 0.05
  }
}
```

Eva L: prefer `sample_rate` instead of `sampling_rate` (brevity). server should enforce a platform max (e.g. 0.2) unless an admin escalation is present.

Kevin B: +1 on the max. Also we need to surface cohort denominator in the console preview — 5% of 1M != 5% of 10k, PMs get confused.

Sana R: UX: where does this live in the rollout flow? global default, model-level, route-level?

Matthew G: propose two layers: policy-level default (applies org-wide) + per-route override. If per-route override > policy_max, API returns 409 unless `admin_approval=true`. Also add a required justification string for admin overrides.

Eva L: telemetry wise emit these fields: `sample_rate`, `cohort_size_estimate`, `expected_qps_estimate`, and `rollout_id`. Tag logs with `billing_exempt` when dry-run.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: config-service v4.12.3 -> canary :rocket:

Kevin B: one more: how do we handle dry-run? I want dry-run to simulate routing and emit metrics but not count against customer quota or billing.

Matthew G: plan: dry-run sets `billing_exempt: true` on routed requests; platform will still record tokens and route decisions but mark records so billing pipeline ignores them. We'll keep replay capability to run cost projections later.

Sana R: can we show an "estimated bill delta" in the console preview? Even a rough ballpark reduces surprises for PMs and finance.

Eva L: yep — and add an alert rule if projected delta > threshold (e.g., $5k/day). Also surface historical similar-rollout deltas to improve estimate.

Matthew G: I'll open a PR w/ API schema + example requests and a separate mockup for console preview. tagging @Kevin B for telemetry schema and @Sana R for UX review. :eyes: :shipit:
